propositions: Coverage instrumentation is currently applied identically to all three Ubuntu cells (3.11, 3.12, 3.13) despite no production source code having sys.version branches, resulting in duplicate measurement overhead without distinct coverage verdicts.

Measured instrumentation cost is approximately 34 wall seconds per uninstrumented cell on the same checkout and tests, confirming pytest-cov tracing adds real runner occupancy without behavioral diversity.

Coverage collection should be restricted to Ubuntu Python 3.13 (the primary/newest stable cell) while all four matrix cells retain both default and integration pytest tiers uninstrumented on 3.11/3.12/macOS.
Django, NumPy, and SciPy all selectively collect coverage on a single dedicated or primary cell configuration while broader compatibility jobs run uninstrumented, establishing consensus precedent.

The workflow contract must enforce that only Ubuntu Python 3.13 receives both coverage flags (--cov and branch=true) while all other cells receive neither, with explicit truthy and-slot and empty-string final or-slot to avoid GitHub Actions empty-string-falsy trap.
